title: Plan National de Développement 2018-2022 — Programme Pluriannuel des Actions Prioritaires, Annexe Opérationnelle N°1
why_not: Dated 2018, before the 2019 floor, and a plan that lapsed in 2022: it says computerisation of police and gendarmerie and networking of operational points lack effectiveness and targets 40% of the force publique's three networks, but states nothing on station records.
